channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Journalism & Writers, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Journalism & Writers, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Sundance Episodic Lab 2027: Alfred P. Sloan Grant Track (science and technology series) (closes 3 Dec)
item.description:
Sundance Institute with the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation
Deadline: 3 Dec 2026
Award: USD 17,000 grant plus creative support through the Episodic Lab. Submission fee waived with code EpSloanGrantX121426 on FilmFreeway.

An extended Sloan-only round of the Sundance Episodic Lab for original half-hour or one-hour series whose subject is science, technology or mathematics, or a scientist, engineer or mathematician. Open to a writer or a two-person writing team.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IWMF: Fund for Indigenous Journalists and Allies (Reporting on MMIP/MMIWG2T) (rolling)
item.description:
International Women's Media Foundation (IWMF)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Grants average up to USD 5,000; proposals over USD 10,000 considered on a limited basis. Plus editorial and pitching support. No application fee stated.

The IWMF Fund for Indigenous Journalists supports in-depth reporting on Missing and Murdered Indigenous People, Women, Girls and Two-Spirit people (MMIP/MMIWG2T).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Kent Cultural Alliance SFW Residency, Spring 2027 "SERVICE": six-week live-in residency in Chestertown, Maryland (USD 7,500 stipend) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Kent Cultural Alliance
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 17:00 EST
Award: USD 7,500 stipend for the six-week session, travel reimbursed up to USD 1,000, studio and gallery expenses reimbursed up to USD 1,500, and on-site housing with a private en-suite bedroom. No application fee.

A community-engaged residency on Maryland's Eastern Shore. Three artists live and work for six weeks in the Raimond Cultural Center, a restored historic house, around the theme SERVICE, working with local partners For All Seasons, the Kent County Food Pantry and Sumner Hall.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Craigardan Trillium Fellowship 2027 (residency for artists, activists and scholars of color, USD 4,600 + USD 500 honorarium) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Craigardan
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: USD 4,600 fellowship toward a minimum two-week residency (covers the residency fee), plus a USD 500 honorarium. Travel, materials and personal expenses are not covered. USD 25 application fee (waivers available on request).

The Trillium Fellowship supports artists, activists and scholars of color working in any discipline who would benefit from the time and space to pursue their work or find creative retreat at Craigardan, a residency and farm in the Adirondacks.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Folger Institute Artistic Research Fellowships 2027-28 (USD 4,000 to 5,000 per month) (closes 15 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Folger Shakespeare Library (Folger Institute)
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 4,000 per virtual month or USD 5,000 per onsite month.

Artistic research fellowships for artists whose work needs primary research on the early modern world (about 1400 to 1800) and its legacies, using the Folger's collections. ELIGIBILITY: any artist; no degree required and no citizenship rule stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Spencer Education Journalism Fellowship 2027-28 (Columbia Journalism School) (closes 4 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Spencer Fellowship at Columbia Journalism School
Deadline: 4 Feb 2027
Award: Residential stipend USD 85,000 or non-residential stipend USD 43,000, plus a USD 7,500 travel and research budget. Non-residential fellows also get airfare and hotel for required NYC trips. No application fee.

The Spencer Education Journalism Fellowship, based at Columbia Journalism School, supports ambitious, research-savvy storytellers producing books, magazine features, documentaries and podcasts that deepen public understanding of critical issues in education.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Museum of Fine Arts, Houston: Core Residency Program 2027-29 (USD 100,000 over 23 months, artists and critical writers) (closes 8 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Core Residency Program, Glassell School of Art, Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH)
Deadline: 8 Jan 2027
Award: USD 100,000 (USD 50,000 per year) plus a health and wellness stipend, private studio, and free or discounted Glassell School classes. Application fee USD 12.

Two-year residency for exceptional, highly motivated emerging artists and critical writers committed to developing a sustainable practice.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.
